assessment: This study provides an important starting point for unraveling the molecular basis of the pathological phenotypes of the repeat expansion in the gene associated with open-reading frame 72 in human chromosome 9. The coarse-grained simulation method used by the authors goes beyond the state of the art, investigating a compelling number of binding partners. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is solid, although experimental validation of the results would strengthen the major conclusions of the work. The work will be of broad interest to biophysicists and biochemists.
